role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 对工程师而言，战斗就是搞恶作剧。嘻嘻哈哈地在战场上抛出粘性炸弹，他们隐形的爆炸地雷、让敌人束手束脚的电击还有英勇无畏的爆破攻击都足以让大多数敌人丢掉性命。或至少大发雷霆。往往两者兼有。
hero_summary_en: For the Techies, battle is a matter of mischief. Giggling while they lob sticky bombs around the battlefield, their hidden explosive mines, disarming zaps, and reckless blast-off attacks are enough to leave most enemies dead. Or at least enraged. Often both.

abilities.name: techies_sticky_bomb
abilities.description_zh: 向目标区域抛出一个粘性炸弹。如果炸弹落在一个敌方英雄身旁，炸弹会粘上去，减缓其移动速度。数秒后炸弹会爆炸，对爆炸区域内造成伤害，并再次施加减速，持续%secondary_slow_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Lobs a Sticky Bomb towards the target area. If it lands next to an enemy hero, the bomb will stick to it, slowing its movement speed. After a few seconds the bomb will explode, dealing damage in an area around the detonation and applying a secondary slow for %secondary_slow_duration% seconds.

abilities.name: techies_reactive_tazer
abilities.description_zh: 工程师对友军目标放出电荷，使他们短时间内获得移动速度加成。攻击目标的敌人会受到伤害被暂时缴械，并且受到弱驱散效果。效果结束时，或者用子技能提前引爆后电荷将会爆炸，使范围内所有敌人缴械并受到伤害。
abilities.description_en: Techies trigger an electric charge on the target ally, giving them bonus movement speed for a short period of time. Enemies attacking the target take damage and are temporarily disarmed and get a Basic Dispel.At the end of the effect or if detonated early with the sub-ability, the charge explodes, disarming all enemies within the radius and dealing damage.

abilities.name: techies_suicide
abilities.description_zh: 工程师冲到敌人中间，在相遇时引爆炸药，造成大量范围伤害，并眩晕敌人。引爆时会对工程师造成当前生命值一定百分比的非致死伤害。
abilities.description_en: Techies hurtle themselves into the enemy's midst, detonating charges upon impact which deal massive area of effect damage and stun enemies. Upon landing, the assault deals Techies non-lethal damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
notes_zh: 工程师在此次爆炸中受到的自身伤害为纯粹伤害，而且不会致死。
notes_en: The self-damage Techies receive from this blast is pure and non-lethal.
facet_text_en: Increased Blast Off! damage and self damage.
facet_text_zh: 提升爆破起飞！伤害和对自身伤害。

abilities.name: techies_mutually_assured_destruction
abilities.description_zh: 工程师获得相当于最大魔法值一定百分比的魔法恢复。工程师阵亡时，他们会留下一个木桶，在%explosion_delay%秒后爆炸，对范围内敌人造成伤害。伤害数值是根据工程师的最大魔法值。
abilities.description_en: Techies gain a percentage of their mana pool as bonus mana regeneration.When Techies die, they leave behind a barrel that explodes after %explosion_delay%s, damaging enemies in an area around it. Damage is based on Techies' max mana.

shard_loc.en: M.A.D. becomes an active ability. Increases max mana as damage amount. Techies plant an M.A.D. which can be detonated manually with a sub-ability. Only one M.A.D. from the active ability can be placed at a time.
shard_loc.zh: 同归于尽变为主动技能。提升最大魔法值的伤害系数。工程师放置同归于尽木桶后，可以使用子技能手动引爆。同一时间主动技能只能放下一个同归于尽木桶。

abilities.name: techies_minefield_sign
abilities.description_zh: 在指定地点放置警示牌，使作用范围内的感应地雷为无敌状态，并且造成的伤害增加%bonus_mine_damage_pct%%%。同一时间只能存在一个标识。持续%lifetime%秒。敌方英雄进入标识的%trigger_radius%范围内时标识附近整个%aura_radius%范围变成一片雷区，持续%minefield_duration%秒。敌方单位在区域内移动都会受到伤害。雷区持续时间结束后标识会被摧毁。
abilities.description_en: Plant a warning sign, causing Proximity Mines within its radius to be invulnerable and deal %bonus_mine_damage_pct%%% more damage. Only one sign can exist at a time. Lasts %lifetime% seconds.When an enemy Hero walks within %trigger_radius% units of a minefield sign, the %aura_radius% units area around the sign will become a minefield for %minefield_duration% seconds, dealing damage to enemy Heroes any time they move within its area. Minefield Sign is destroyed after this effect ends.

abilities.name: techies_land_mines
abilities.description_zh: 埋布隐形的地雷，不会被真实视域检测到，但是有敌方单位在地雷的%radius%生效范围内会显形。敌人在生效范围内停留超过%proximity_threshold%秒会使地雷爆炸，并且魔法抗性会被暂时降低。爆炸对%min_distance%范围内目标造成全额伤害，对边缘造成的伤害减少至%outer_damage%%%。对建筑物造成%building_damage_pct%%%伤害。
abilities.description_en: Plant an invisible mine that cannot be detected by True Sight, but is visible if an enemy is within the active %radius% AoE of the mine. Mines detonate if an enemy is standing within the active AoE for %proximity_threshold% seconds dealing damage and temporarily reducing the enemy's Magic Resistance. The explosion deals full damage if the target is within %min_distance% radius and decreases down to %outer_damage%%% on the edge. Deals %building_damage_pct%%% damage to buildings.
notes_zh: 感应地雷的%placement_radius%范围内不能再放置地雷。
感应地雷不会阻止中立生物产生。
地雷持续时间没有上限，除非爆炸或被摧毁。
隐形单位也能触发地雷。
敌方英雄将地雷摧毁可以获得30金钱。
notes_en: Cannot be placed within %placement_radius% AoE of another Proximity Mine.
Proximity Mines do not block neutral creep camps from spawning.
Mines last until they explode or are destroyed.
Mines are triggered by invisible units.
Grants 30 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_techies_tazer_duration
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_duration}% Reactive Tazer Buff and Disarm Duration
